newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-BIG CHANCE FOR BERGKAMP TO CLOSE ON RECORD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BIG CHANCE FOR BERGKAMP TO CLOSE ON RECORD.

text.p: Arsenal striker Dennis Bergkamp has a golden opportunity to close in on the Dutch international scoring record in the World Cup qualifier at home to San Marino on Saturday.
In their last two meetings, the Dutch have won 7-0 and 6-0 and Bergkamp, with 30 goals to his name in 53 internationals, is currently only five short of the record held by Faas Wilkes.
"I'm not going to just smack every ball at the goal if I see that someone else is in a better position," Bergkamp said. "But it's true it's difficult not to think about the record."
Ajax midfielder Ronald de Boer is resting a painful knee and will sit out the game.
"It is getting harder and harder for me to continue playing midweek and on the weekend," he said. "I need more time to recover."
